title: Hilbert-Schmidt Lipschitz bridge for the capped Liouvillian kernel
question: Can the unit scalar Lipschitz bound for the capped Matsubara kernel be lifted to a gap-free Hilbert-Schmidt functional-calculus comparison of finite Liouvillians, thereby isolating eigenvector rotation from spatial locality?
promotion_boundary: R-376 is a finite small-edge Liouvillian Hilbert-Schmidt stress and a functional-calculus route interface. It does not prove the general Schatten-2 theorem, an operator-norm bound, spatial locality, a common core or a common alpha.
next_action: Establish the general Schatten-2 functional-calculus lemma for the capped kernel, then combine it with an energy-constrained local commutator estimate on the common polynomial core.
boundary: Finite V=2, cutoff 2 Liouvillian comparisons with two beta values and two noncommuting perturbation scales, linked to the R-375 all-prefix source run. Global KMS, common core, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS dynamics, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain open.
